question: Which Indian para-athlete became the first para archer to receive the Padma Shri after winning a historic gold medal at the 2024 Paris Paralympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Harvinder Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Harvinder Singh is an Indian para archer who made history by winning a gold medal at the 2024 Paris Paralympics in the men’s individual recurve event.

• He became the first para archer in India to receive the prestigious Padma Shri award for his outstanding achievements in sports.

• Harvinder Singh has also previously won a bronze medal at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics, marking India’s first-ever Paralympic medal in archery.

• He hails from the state of Punjab and has overcome physical challenges to establish himself as a trailblazer in para archery.

• His dedication and success have inspired countless individuals with disabilities to pursue sports and achieve their dreams.

• **Rakesh Kumar:**

• Rakesh Kumar is an Indian para archer who has represented India in international competitions, including the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.

• He competed in the men’s compound archery category but did not win a medal at the Tokyo Paralympics.

• Kumar is known for his remarkable consistency in the sport, often ranking high in international para archery events.

• **Mariyappan Thangavelu:**

• Mariyappan Thangavelu is an Indian para-athlete specializing in high jump.

• He won a gold medal in the men’s T-42 high jump at the Rio 2016 Paralympics and a silver medal at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.

• Thangavelu is a recipient of the Padma Shri and the Khel Ratna awards for his contributions to sports.

• **Sumit Antil:**

• Sumit Antil is an Indian para-athlete who competes in javelin throw and won a historic gold medal at the Tokyo 2020 Paralympics.

• He set a world record in the men’s F64 javelin throw category during the Tokyo Paralympics, demonstrating exceptional skill and athleticism.

• Sumit has been honored with the Padma Shri for his outstanding achievements in para-athletics.
